items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: Well that was before Robinson so I knew then, I knew more about the Negro leagues, and I followed them very closely because of the Pittsburgh Courier and the Chicago Defender and the black publications that I read voraciously, as I read the white publications as well.

ctx.x: Well that was before Robinson so I knew then, I knew more about the Negro leagues, and I followed them very closely because of the Pittsburgh Courier and the Chicago Defender and the black publications that I read voraciously, as I read the white publications as well. And the Cubs were perennial losers. And the White Sox were just as bad over there and the Yankees.
That’s when they had Orestes Minoso, wasn’t it?
